game.title: Elle
game.description: A traditional bat-and-ball game similar to cricket and gillidanda, played with a curved stick (elle) and a wooden ball. Considered one of Sri Lanka's oldest traditional sports.
game.location: Throughout Sri Lanka, especially rural areas
game.occasion: Festivals, village gatherings, Sinhala and Tamil New Year
howToPlay: Step 1: Two teams take positions in a large open field.
Step 2: Similar to cricket, one team bats while the other fields.
Step 3: The batter uses the curved elle stick to hit the wooden ball.
Step 4: Runs are scored by running between designated points.
Step 5: Fielders try to catch the ball or hit the wickets.
Step 6: The game requires hand-eye coordination and running speed.
Step 7: Teams switch roles after all batters are out.
Step 8: The team with most runs wins.
Step 9: Popular during traditional New Year celebrations.
Step 10: Preserved as part of Sri Lankan cultural heritage.
